hero.seoH1: Industrial solutions for die casting, automation and robotics
hero.paragraph1: AZ Consulting & Trade supports manufacturers in the engineering, installation and maintenance of industrial plants, automation systems and die casting solutions.
hero.paragraph2: From technical consulting to direct supply, we develop solutions designed to improve efficiency, reliability and productivity.
hero.imageAlt: Industrial plant with robotic arms and automated production line

intro.body1: Every industrial plant has specific requirements.
intro.body2: That's why we start by analysing the production process, identifying critical points and developing technical solutions that genuinely integrate with the customer's production.
intro.body3: A single point of contact for consulting, engineering, installation, maintenance and supply.

services.sectionSubtitle: From initial analysis to production start-up, we support customers through the entire lifecycle of the plant.

items.title: Die casting solutions
items.text: We support companies in optimising die casting processes, selecting the right technologies and integrating equipment within production lines.

items.title: Automating production processes
items.text: We design and integrate automation solutions built to increase productivity, precision and operational continuity.

items.title: Robotics integrated into production
items.text: We integrate industrial robots and automated systems into production processes, developing custom solutions based on each plant's needs.

items.title: Engineering & Industrial Consulting
items.text: We support customers in the technical and strategic decisions behind their production plants. From initial analysis through to execution, we coordinate technologies, suppliers and operational activities.

trade.body1: Thanks to our market knowledge and an established network of partners and manufacturers, AZ Consulting & Trade can directly supply machinery, components and solutions for industry.
trade.body2: Our value isn't simply finding a product, but identifying the technically best-suited solution for the customer's production process.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.text: We analyse the process, the plant and the production goals.

steps.title: Engineering
steps.text: We define the most effective technical solution.

steps.title: Integration
steps.text: We coordinate technologies, equipment and automation.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We oversee installation, commissioning and start-up.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: We provide ongoing technical assistance and maintenance.

items.title: Hands-on experience
items.text: We understand the real needs of industrial production and work with a hands-on, operational approach.

items.title: Tailored solutions
items.text: Every project is developed around the customer's specific technical and production requirements.

items.title: From consulting to supply
items.text: We can manage the entire project: analysis, engineering, supply, installation and maintenance.
